description.text: Black smoke tears open above a burning battlefield as a huge black dragon drops through in a steep, low glide. Its scarred scales catch the firelight, and the torn membranes of its wings snap with each heavy beat. A knight in battered, soot-blackened plate armour is braced low in the saddle, shield strapped to one arm, the visor down and the metal streaked with ash. Below them, shattered siege lines, broken engines and burning trenches rush past in a blur of orange flame and rolling smoke. Embers streak through the air, and the dragon's shadow skims across the ruined ground as the pair descends toward the flames.
A huge black dragon breaks through black smoke and descends over a burning battlefield.
Deep wingbeats and roaring fire fill the air.
The knight braces low in the saddle as embers streak past.
Wind rushes past armour and distant explosions rumble.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

The dragon banks hard over a burning trench line, its body tilting so the knight swings into view against the firelit smoke. The knight rises in the stirrups, armour plates creaking and scraping as the turn presses him against the saddle. With one gauntleted hand he flips up his visor and shouts forward across the battlefield, his voice carried briefly through the wind and fire-roar. Firelight washes over the scarred dragon hide and the knight's battered plate; the dragon's head stays low and forward as it sweeps across the broken trenches, the battlefield sliding beneath them in a rush of flame, smoke and scattered debris.
The dragon banks hard over a burning trench line, tilting the knight into view.
Armour plates creak and the dragon gives a deep rumble.
The knight rises in the stirrups, lifts his visor and shouts forward.
Fire crackles and wind buffets the pair.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

The dragon flares its wings and climbs steeply, embers swirling off its back and scattering into the smoke. The knight stays small in the saddle, braced low as the pair rises away from the flames. Below, the burning battlefield spreads out in a field of fire and broken ground, with shattered siege lines and trenches glowing through the haze. Heavy wingbeats carry them upward, the wind tearing at the knight's armour and the dragon's torn membranes, while the firelight fades beneath them and the smoke closes around the climbing pair.
The dragon flares its wings and climbs steeply, embers swirling off its back.
Heavy wingbeats and rushing wind carry the pair upward.
The burning battlefield spreads out below in a field of fire and broken ground.
Distant fire roar fades beneath the climbing pair.
The camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed.
